title: OversightVerdict
description: The Human Oversight agent's structured response, normalized by environment/oversight.py::parse_oversight_verdict. Unlike every other gate in this project, there is no deterministic correct verdict to check this against -- the one enforced rule is that an unparseable or malformed response degrades to 'flagged', never silently to 'approved' (mirrors the sibling ML pipeline's Verification agent rule exactly).
